summary: Biomea Fusion filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5, Rule 424(b)(5)) for an underwritten follow-on offering of common stock and, to certain investors, pre-funded warrants priced at the public offering price minus $0.0001 with a $0.0001 exercise price. Konik Capital Partners, a division of T.R. Winston, is underwriter, receiving warrants for 7% of shares sold at 250% of the offering price and a 30-day option for additional shares. Amounts and pricing are blank; BMEA closed at $1.71 on September 21, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch final pricing, dilution and warrant overhang.
